name: Patch Madras
description: Squares of bleeding madras plaid sewn edge to edge, each patch dyed its own colors, the stripes soft as if the dye had run.

code.style: --rule: ( background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(1.5%); clip-path: inset(1.5%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); opacity: .7; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 12% 30%, transparent 36% 52%, #000 56% 62%, transparent 66% 76%, #000 80% 86%, transparent 90%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 12% 30%, transparent 36% 52%, #000 56% 62%, transparent 66% 76%, #000 80% 86%, transparent 90%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); opacity: .55; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 4%, #000 10% 22%, transparent 28% 44%, #000 50% 70%, transparent 76% 84%, #000 88% 92%, transparent 96%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 4%, #000 10% 22%, transparent 28% 44%, #000 50% 70%, transparent 76% 84%, #000 88% 92%, transparent 96%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
